registered: 2026-11-07 ~04:00 ET, before any code or data pull for this study. The only premarket looks so far are (a) the 11/06 quick look (buy the minute after the first alert, hold 30 min, GROSS: premarket $2+ n 86 mean -366 bp) and (b) the count-only run (tools/studies/momentum_premarket.py count, 892 name-days); both are disclosed and neither scored a rule below.
operator: 2026-11-07: asked what gives the highest odds; the answer was to test premarket ideas on free historical SIP before buying SIP; operator 'do that'.
question: On the momentum-alert names the operator pays for, does any of TWO simple premarket entry rules make money after real SIP spreads, beat a random minute on the same name, and hold in both halves, using only free historical SIP bars and quotes?
sample: Every session 2026-09-16 .. 2026-11-05 whose ai_reports/sessions/DAY/discord.jsonl.gz has an alert line before 07:00 ET (about 30 sessions), split by date into EARLY and LATE halves (equal session counts). Name-day = the first alert for a symbol in the session with alert time t0 between 04:00:00 and 09:15:00 ET (the same definition as the 11/06 count). Price at t0 = the close of the last SIP 1-minute bar at or before t0, at most 5 minutes old, and >= $2.00; otherwise dropped and counted. Excluded: levered/inverse/ETF symbols (the desk's is_not_stock list) and names without at least 15 SIP 1-minute bars in the 60 minutes before t0.
data: Free historical SIP 1-minute bars 04:00-09:30 and SIP quotes (all older than 15 minutes). No subscription. Bars are labelled by START time; a bar is usable only after it closes (start + 60 s). Premarket gaps (no bar) are NOT filled.

definitions.L0: lowest low of the last 15 closed bars before t0
definitions.R1_pullback_holds (the operator's 1-2-3): From t0 track the running high H. A PULLBACK is confirmed at the first bar whose close is at least max(30% of (H - L0), 50 bp of price) below H; point 1 = H at that moment, H1. Point 2 = the lowest low after the pullback began; it must stay ABOVE L0 (any bar with low <= L0 cancels the setup). Point 3 = the first later bar whose high reaches H1 x 1.0005; buy-stop fill at max(H1 x 1.0005, that bar's open). Point 3 must occur within 45 minutes of t0 and before 09:15 ET.
definitions.R2_range_breakout: The RANGE = the high and low of the 10 minutes after t0 (the 10 bars starting at t0's minute+1, usable when the 10th closes). Buy-stop = range high x 1.0005, active from the first bar after the range closes until 40 minutes after t0 and before 09:15 ET; fill at max(stop, that bar's open). Cancelled if a bar's low is <= range low x 0.995 before the trigger.
definitions.exit: Primary, same for both rules and the control: sell at the close of the bar that closes 10 minutes after the fill minute, but never later than the 09:24 bar close (the operator's 09:25 liquidation); a hard stop 5% below the fill (ai_phase_b_hard_stop_pct) checked on bar lows from the bar after the fill, filled at the stop price. Information: 5-, 20-minute holds.

costing: Every fill pays half the median SIP quoted spread (bp of mid, bid > 0, ask > bid, time-weighted) over the 60 s before the fill minute, minimum 5 bp per side premarket, plus 3 bp round trip. A trade with fewer than 20 usable quotes in that window at entry or exit is dropped and counted (price unusable).

controls.random_minute: Same name-day, same rule's detector is NOT used: a random bar uniformly from [t0 - 60, t0 + 60] minutes excluding |delta| < 5 and before 09:15, buy at the next bar open, same exit and costs, seeded sha256(symbol|day|'PM-rand'). Lift = rule net minus the random-minute net on the same name-days that have both.

statistic: Per day: mean net bp over that day's rule trades. Day-clustered t (n-1 df, one-sided) over days with a trade; lift likewise.
pass: STRONG for a rule only if ALL: (1) mean per-day net > 0 with t >= 2.24 (family of two rules, alpha 0.0125); (2) mean per-day net > 0 in BOTH halves; (3) lift vs the random minute > 0 in BOTH halves; (4) at least 100 trades in total and at least 40 per half, else UNDERPOWERED (no verdict; the forward SIP month decides); (5) the pooled net stays > 0 after dropping the best 3 days and, separately, the 3 names with the largest total P&L; (6) under 1.5x the quoted-spread costs the pooled net stays > 0.
void: More than 25% of name-days dropped for missing bars/quotes (premarket is sparse), or fewer than 20 sessions usable: the study is VOID and is not scored.
fail: Any other missing condition = FAIL. No other threshold, window, stop or rule is scored as primary.
information_only: R3 buy the minute after the alert with a 5-minute hold (the 11/06 rule, net of real spreads)
share of name-days reaching the entry
never-green share of the entries (peak < fill + 5 bp)
rules on name-days under $2 (no pass; spreads are huge)
if_pass: result-skeptic review; then it earns the paid SIP month as a FORWARD DRY-RUN of the same rule on live prints (never live money without a separate approval). A fail closes premarket-on-history and the SIP month is not justified by this study.
caveats: The alert timestamps are OCR capture times; t0 can lag the true alert.
Historical prints are consolidated SIP; a live order needs real-time SIP, which is why a pass only earns a forward test.
tool: tools/studies/premarket_rules_history.py (built after this file is committed and a result-skeptic READY; may not change anything above)

amended.when: 2026-11-07 ~04:30 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (8 findings), before any code or data pull.
amended.1_timing_dst: Replaces the price-at-t0 line: price at t0 = the close of the last bar whose start + 60 s <= t0 (at most 5 minutes old). All clock times are converted with America/New_York per timestamp (the sample spans the 11/01 DST change); the tool asserts that each alert line's `et` field equals the converted `ts`. R1/R2 may use only bars with start + 60 s <= the decision instant.
amended.2_alert_definition: Replaces the name-day definition: t0 is the first alert for a symbol in the session, dropped (and counted) if it falls within 10 minutes of that session's first capture line, or if the same symbol appeared in the previous session's last 30 minutes of captures. t0 must be >= 05:00 ET so the 60-minute lookback is real, and <= 09:15. The `burst` field is not used for selection. Information cell: lag proxy = minutes from t0 back to the first bar with volume >= 5x its prior-15-bar median.
amended.3_fills: The stop fills at min(stop, that bar's open); the fill bar's own low counts as a stop trigger if it is <= the stop. If the trigger bar's low <= L0 (R1) or <= range low x 0.995 (R2), the setup is cancelled (same-bar ties cancel). The exit is at the close of the bar starting at fill + 10 minutes, capped so the exit bar starts no later than 09:24; if that bar is absent, the exit is the open of the next existing bar; a stale close is never used. A fill requires the fill bar's volume >= 200 shares and >= $2,000, else the trade is dropped and counted.
amended.4_cost: A trade is dropped only for ENTRY-quote sparsity (< 20 usable quotes in the 60 s before the fill minute; known at decision time). A sparse EXIT uses an exit half-spread of max(entry half-spread, 50 bp) (a 100 bp quoted spread). The 1.5x test applies to all spread components including the 5 bp floor; a 2x cell is information only.
amended.5_control: Replaces the control: 20 random minutes per name-day, each drawn uniformly from [t0 + 5 min, t0 + 60 min], before 09:15 and within +-30 minutes of the rule's own fill clock time, entry at the next bar open, same exit and costs; the 20 are averaged per name-day. Lift is computed on name-days where the rule traded. Seed: sha256(symbol|day|'PM-rand'|k).
amended.6_statistics: Replaces the 2.24 bar: pass needs t >= the Student-t critical value at one-sided 0.0125 with df = (days with a trade) - 1. Order of evaluation: VOID, then UNDERPOWERED (n < 100 trades total or < 40 in either half; no verdict), then FAIL, then STRONG. Before scoring the tool reports the per-trade SD and MDE = 2.4 x SD / sqrt(n_days).
amended.7_clustering_and_multiplicity: One position per name-day per rule. Pooled and per-half tests also report a name-clustered t (cluster by symbol) and a pass needs BOTH clusterings to meet the bar. Information cells (R3, 5/20-minute holds, price bands, sub-$2) can never promote a pass or justify the SIP spend. Disclosed: the long side was chosen after the 11/06 look at this same sample showed a fade.
amended.8_void_denominator: Denominator = all first-alert name-days that are stocks, >= $2, with 05:00 <= t0 <= 09:15. Every exclusion (ETF, < 15 bars, stale t0, no quotes, no fill bar, no exit) is reported in a drop table. The study is VOID if bar or quote drops exceed 25% of that denominator. The count of dropped trades is reported per rule.
